facts.fact: The director general of the digital economy agency ADEN told the National Assembly's finance committee on 16 July 2026 that a tax on newly imported SIM-equipped terminals, set up by the 2026 finance law and in force since 1 June 2026, is paid by importers by bank transfer and is meant to finance the digital ecosystem's structuring projects and connectivity; the article does not name the provision that assigns the yield or give any amount collected.
facts.system: Taxe sur les nouveaux terminaux numériques à cartes SIM

note: Assignment of the yield to digital programmes rests on the agency head's account, not on a quoted article of the law; no collected amount given.
